principles: Evidence is interpreted support/contradiction derived from observations.
Beliefs are always revisable and evidence-backed.
Decisions optimize expected value of next state, not immediate action score.
Objective coverage gates completion, not perceived progress.
Knowledge and Experience are separate stores.
Learn from both success and failure.
required_capabilities: Working theories created only from discovered evidence

implemented: Grounded resolution consumes deterministic and brain hints
missing: Observation vs Evidence split in runtime state
Belief state and working theory manager
Objective coverage gate as formal completion criterion
Separate Experience store with policy/failure priors
Production validation of indexing and graph/vector dependencies
why_not_99_confident_yet: Core dynamic policy rewrite is not fully implemented yet.
Experience base for these ticket families is still sparse.
Operational dependencies (indexing/sqlite/neo4j/vector/build) are not fully verified in target run path.
Cross-service refactor ticket (canonical source centralization) needs real end-to-end proof.

verification_protocol.goal: Establish operational confidence gates before claiming high confidence

gates.name: Index and stores available
must_pass: Vector retrieval returns non-empty context for known literals

gates.name: Action policy dynamic behavior
must_pass: Different next actions chosen for materially different states

gates.name: Objective coverage correctness
must_pass: Ticket completion blocked when any acceptance objective remains open

gates.name: Ticket references
must_pass: Ticket 1 solved with correct owner and UI verification
Ticket 3 solved with backend policy enforcement and exception handling
Ticket 2 solved or minimized with explicit explanation of technical constraints
